title: Central's causal-completion pull and settlement defer remote runs silently or with generic pending instead of naming the deciding guard
outcome: When Central cannot pull or settle a remote run's native completion, the original request row and its read surface name the exact deciding guard and its release condition, instead of a silent `continue` or a generic "pending".
acceptance: Each deferral in Central's causal-completion pull (current custody, peer or lease, relay timeout or error, completion None, invalid or mismatched completion, post-I/O custody mismatch; test_run_causal_completion_batch.rs ~191-278) records a typed reason that names the deciding check and its release condition, readable through the existing original-row or diagnostics surface, bounded and with no secrets.

Settlement (causal_test_admission_target and engram_causal_completion_delivery recovery) reports the exact target, capability, transport or receipt failure through the same surface instead of a generic pending string. Batch and settlement errors are no longer discarded. Idempotent saved-completion replay and the landed per-row scan fix are preserved.
Behavioural tests drive at least the completion-None, relay-error and target-resolution cases and assert the surfaced reason. No test pins message text beyond the typed stage and check.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree that lands.

completion.summary:
Central's causal-completion pull and settlement now name the deciding guard and its release condition on the original request row and its diagnostics surface. They no longer continue silently or show a generic pending.

- Pre-send refusals and deadlines are typed as local route, capacity or local-check reasons, never origin failures. Nothing is sent after the caller's deadline.
- Settlement steps name their own failure (read, save, completion conflict).
- Recovery-batch, worker and pending-write failures are counted by stage with closed log classes.
- One shared ready-plan transition moves pull-phase reasons to admission_pending when a saved settlement will be replayed, and keeps recorded settlement failures.
